summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AI Command Center features in BillFlow app. All AI integration features working perfectly with 100% success rate. Backend AI endpoints (parse-notes, execute-plan) functioning correctly with OpenAI GPT-4.1 via Emergent LLM. Frontend UI fully functional with proper AI workflow, action toggles, document creation, and WhatsApp mock notifications. Dashboard stats update correctly after AI creates documents.
passed_tests: AI Command Center page loads at /notes with textarea, AI Process button, OCR Scan button
Backend POST /api/ai/parse-notes - accepts rough notes and returns structured data (customer, items, delivery, actions)
Backend POST /api/ai/execute-plan - creates all selected documents (invoice, quotation, challan, e-way bill)
AI parsing correctly extracts customer details from existing database (Sharma ji matched)
AI parsing correctly extracts multiple items with quantities and rates (50 laptops at Rs.45,000, 100 monitors at Rs.12,000)
AI parsing correctly identifies delivery details (vehicle MH12AB1234, Pune location)
AI parsing suggests appropriate actions (invoice, quotation, delivery_challan)
Frontend AI Process button sends notes to backend and displays AI plan with customer, items, actions
Frontend action toggles (invoice, quotation, delivery_challan, eway_bill) work correctly
Frontend supply type buttons (intra-state, inter-state) work correctly
Frontend plan editing - customer name, item quantities, and rates are editable
Frontend Execute All button creates all selected documents successfully
Frontend shows results with created document numbers (INV-0005, QT-0003, DC-0003, EWB-0003)
Notes History section shows all notes with proper AI/MANUAL/OCR badges
Save Note Only button works for manual notes
WhatsApp mock notifications appear as Sonner toasts for each AI action
WhatsApp notifications stored in database and displayed in dashboard feed
Dashboard stats update after AI creates documents (revenue, invoices, quotations, challans, e-way bills)
Dashboard WhatsApp Alerts feed shows AI-related notifications with proper timestamps
New Task button successfully resets AI workspace to idle state
Start Over button allows restarting the AI process
AI processing and execution states display correctly with loading indicators
All previously working features still function: customers, products, invoices, quotations, challans, e-way bills CRUD
AI integration uses Emergent LLM key with OpenAI GPT-4.1 model successfully
AI responses include proper summary of what was understood
AI correctly matches existing customers and products from database
AI handles complex business scenarios with multiple items and delivery requirements
